package.name: gnocchi
package.description:
GNOCCHI: Global Navigation from Odometry Constraints and Covariance-weighted Heading with Incremental Smoothing.
Globally referenced pose estimation. Odometry enters the graph only as relative constraints; GNSS position and heading enter as priors, weighted by the accuracy the receiver reports. One frame, pose only. With no odometry configured it degenerates into a GNSS-to-local-frame converter, which is the UAV profile.
